narrative: Dear claims team, I'm Carlos Mendes (policy WTP-PLS-200342). On 17 July, while hiking the marked Edelweiss trail above Zermatt, I slipped on wet rock and broke my left wrist. I was taken to the clinic in Zermatt and then to Visp hospital, where they reset the bone and put on a cast. I had a follow-up visit before flying home. The bills came to $6,480.00 altogether: emergency room $1,150.00, X-rays $420.00, reduction and cast $3,960.00, follow-up consultation $950.00. Itemised invoices attached. Thank you.
